justifications.type_expressiveness: Newtype JobId, well-modeled JobState enum, typed QueueError variants, and an internal Job struct cleanly encode the domain without stringly-typed or boolean-tagged data.
justifications.error_handling: Typed QueueError with distinguishing variants and Display impl, but the constructor uses assert! to panic on invalid max_attempts and an undocumented expect remains in checkout.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Clean surface with appropriate derives, Display on the error, and doc comments on most public items, though Queue itself lacks Debug/Default and some items (CheckedOut methods) are undocumented.
justifications.idiomaticity: Uses ?, map_or, ok_or, derives, and saturating arithmetic appropriately, but the manual O(n) loop in checkout and payload cloning could be more idiomatic (e.g., iterator min_by_key).
